doc.title: First-Off Approval
doc.purpose: Confirm the first product after a start-up or changeover is right before the line runs at rate.

roles.name: QA Technician
roles.does: Carries out the checks and signs.

references.as_written: WI-211 Capper Setup and Torque Check
QP-316 Customer Complaints and Lot Trace

parameters.quote: Bring the first 5 good bottles and one packed case to the QA bench.
straight within 2 mm, no wrinkles or bubbles

parameters.what: maximum line speed before first-off approval
parameters.quote: Do not run above 50% speed before approval.

rules.statement: The QA Technician checks and signs first-off approval.
rules.quote: All checks pass: sign FRM-QA-06 First-Off Record and tell the Line Lead.

rules.topic: who holds the line until first-off approval
rules.statement: The Line Lead holds the line until approval and corrects any fault.
rules.quote: Any check fails: the line stays stopped. The Line Lead corrects the fault and a new first-off is taken.

unsure.what: Step 3 checks removal torque against 'the range in WI-211'
unsure.why: WI-211's table gives application torque with a tolerance, not a removal torque range

unsure.what: Fill weight check says 'limits in WI-210'
unsure.why: WI-210 limits are per product; which product's limits apply is by context only
